videos.title: Sin City Rehab
videos.description: Alison takes on a personal project for her flipping partner Josh, transforming his home with views of the Vegas Strip for his family of six; Alison lists her Chicago house, hoping to fund her next chapter.

videos.title: My Lottery Dream Home: Where are They Now?
videos.description: David catches up with three lucky winners living their Aloha dreams; one couple embraces island life in Hilo, while another enjoys their Hawaiian retirement; a winner shares their plans for Aloha adventures!

videos.title: My Lottery Dream Home
videos.description: A lucky lady often wins small amounts, but she finally hit it big with $3 million on a scratcher; David Bromstad arrives to help her and her husband upgrade their vacation home for a bougier place in Murrells Inlet, S.C.

videos.title: My Lottery Dream Home
videos.description: After relying on the help of friends and family, a woman needs a suitable place for her disabled husband; David's ready to find their dream home in Fort Pierce, Fla.

videos.title: My Lottery Dream Home
videos.description: After hitting a $926,000 jackpot, a 34-year Chicago police officer is ready to find her dream home outside the city in Crete, Ill.; David finds some properties with sprawling backyards and plenty of room for her nine grandkids to share!

videos.title: My Lottery Dream Home
videos.description: After hitting the jackpot, an ex-servicewoman is ready to leave renting behind and search for her forever home in Greensboro, N.C.; with David and her son along for the ride, she's out to find a home to begin her next chapter.
